===
```{r}
df_qualtrics <- read_csv(here("analysis/data/proc/df_qualtrics.csv"))
```

Process data
===
```{r}
df_vals <- df_analysis %>% 
  filter(str_detect(field, "rate_val")) %>% 
  mutate(val_name = str_remove(field, "rate_val_")) %>% 
  select(convo_id, val_name, content) %>%
  rename(val_rating = content) 
df_vals_person <- df_vals %>% 
  group_by(convo_id) %>%
  summarize(mean_val = mean(as.numeric(val_rating), na.rm=T)) %>% 
  ungroup
```


```{r}
d_top1 <- df_analysis_w %>% 
  select(convo_id, matches("top1"), 
         -contains("_step"), 
         -contains("_idx"),
         -contains("_text")) %>% 
  mutate(reap_category = "top",
         reap_num = "top1") %>% 
  rename_all(~str_remove(., "rate_")) %>% 
  rename_all(~str_remove(., "_?top1")) %>% 
  rename_all(~str_replace_all(., "_rank", "reap_rank"))
d_top2 <- df_analysis_w %>% 
  select(convo_id, matches("top2"), 
         -contains("_step"), 
         -contains("_idx"),
         -contains("_text")) %>% 
  mutate(reap_category = "top",
         reap_num = "top2") %>% 
  rename_all(~str_remove(., "rate_")) %>% 
  rename_all(~str_remove(., "_?top2")) %>% 
  rename_all(~str_replace_all(., "_rank", "reap_rank"))
d_bottom1 <- df_analysis_w %>% 
  select(convo_id, matches("bottom1"), 
         -contains("_step"), 
         -contains("_idx"),
         -contains("_text")) %>% 
  mutate(reap_category = "bottom",
         reap_num = "bottom1") %>% 
  rename_all(~str_remove(., "rate_")) %>% 
  rename_all(~str_remove(., "_?bottom1")) %>% 
  rename_all(~str_replace_all(., "_rank", "reap_rank"))
d_bottom2 <- df_analysis_w %>% 
  select(convo_id, matches("bottom2"), 
         -contains("_step"), 
         -contains("_idx"),
         -contains("_text")) %>% 
  mutate(reap_category = "bottom",
         reap_num = "bottom2") %>% 
  rename_all(~str_remove(., "rate_")) %>% 
  rename_all(~str_remove(., "_?bottom2")) %>% 
  rename_all(~str_replace_all(., "_rank", "reap_rank"))


df_proc <- bind_rows(d_top1, d_top2, d_bottom1, d_bottom2) %>%
  inner_join(df_analysis %>%
              filter(str_detect(field, "rate_issue_pos")) %>%
              select(convo_id, content) %>%
              rename(issue_pos = content) %>%
              mutate(issue_pos = as.numeric(issue_pos))) %>%
  inner_join(df_analysis %>%
              filter(str_detect(field, "rate_issue_neg")) %>%
              select(convo_id, content) %>%
              rename(issue_neg = content) %>%
              mutate(issue_neg = as.numeric(issue_neg))) %>%
  inner_join(df_conversations %>% 
              select(convo_id, pid)) %>%
  inner_join(df_qualtrics %>%
              select(pid, ai_emo,ai_general, gender, secret_word)) %>% 
  filter(secret_word == "treehouse") %>% 
  left_join(
    df_analysis_w %>% 
      select(convo_id, starts_with("rate_val")) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -convo_id, 
                   names_to = "reap_value",
                   names_pattern = "rate_val_(.*)",
                   values_to = "person_value")
  ) %>%
  left_join(df_vals_person) %>%
  mutate(reap_category_binary = if_else(reap_category == "top", 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate_at(vars(ai_emo, ai_general, 
                 person_value, mean_val,
                 reap_pos, reap_neg,
                 reap_care, reap_insight, reap_success,
                 issue_pos, issue_neg), ~./100) %>% 
  group_by(convo_id) %>% 
  mutate(person_value_pc = scale(person_value, scale=F)) %>%
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(ai_emo, ai_general, 
                 person_value, person_value_pc, mean_val,
                 reap_pos, reap_neg,
                 reap_care, reap_insight, reap_success,
                 issue_pos, issue_neg), list(z = scale)) 

effed_up_pids <- df_proc %>% 
  filter(reap_category == "bottom") %>% 
  filter(person_value == 1) %>% 
  pull(pid)

effed_up_pids_2 <- df_proc %>% 
  filter(reap_category == "top") %>% 
  filter(person_value < .10) %>%
  pull(pid)

df_proc <- df_proc %>%
  filter(!pid %in% effed_up_pids) %>% 
  filter(!pid %in% effed_up_pids_2) 

df_proc$pid %>% unique %>% length
```


Define ZOIB
===
```{r}
library(brms)
zi_coi_zoib <- 
  custom_family("zi_coi_zoib", 
                dpars = c("mu", "zi", "coi", "phi"),
                links = c("logit", "logit", "logit", "log"),
                lb = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
                ub = c(1, 1, 1, NA),
                type = "real")
stan_funs <- "
  real zi_coi_zoib_lpdf(real y, real mu, real zi, real coi, real phi) { 
    row_vector[2] shape = [mu * phi, (1 - mu) * phi];
  
    if (y == 0) { 
      return log(zi); 
    } else if (y == 1) {
      return log1m(zi) + log(coi);
    } else {
      return beta_lpdf(y | shape[1], shape[2]) + log1m(zi) + log1m(coi);
    }
  }
"
stanvars <- stanvar(scode = stan_funs, block = "functions")


posterior_predict_zi_coi_zoib <- function(i, prep, ...) {
  mu <- brms::get_dpar(prep, "mu", i = i)
  zi <- brms::get_dpar(prep, "zi", i = i)
  coi <- brms::get_dpar(prep, "coi", i = i)
  phi <- brms::get_dpar(prep, "phi", i = i)
  
  shape1 <- mu * phi
  shape2 <- (1 - mu) * phi
  
  # Generate uniform random variables
  u <- runif(prep$ndraws)
  
  # Compute cumulative probabilities
  cdf_zero <- zi
  cdf_one <- zi + (1 - zi) * coi
  
  # Initialize output vector
  y <- numeric(prep$ndraws)
  
  # Assign outcomes based on cumulative probabilities
  y[u < cdf_zero] <- 0
  y[u >= cdf_zero & u < cdf_one] <- 1
  
  # For the remaining cases, draw from the beta distribution
  beta_indices <- which(u >= cdf_one)
  y[beta_indices] <- rbeta(length(beta_indices), shape1, shape2)
  
  return(y)
}

posterior_epred_zi_coi_zoib <- function(prep) {
  # Extract distributional parameters from 'prep'
  mu <- brms::get_dpar(prep, "mu")
  zi <- brms::get_dpar(prep, "zi")    # Zero-inflation probability
  coi <- brms::get_dpar(prep, "coi")  # Conditional one-inflation probability
  
  # Calculate the expected value E[Y]
  EY <- (1 - zi) * (coi + (1 - coi) * mu)
  
  return(EY)
}
```

mean values
---
```{r}
df_vals %>% 
  group_by(val_name) %>%
  summarize(mean_val = mean(as.numeric(val_rating), na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_val = sd(as.numeric(val_rating), na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            upper_ci = mean_val + 1.96 * sd_val / sqrt(n),
            lower_ci = mean_val - 1.96 * sd_val / sqrt(n)) %>%
  mutate(val_name = fct_reorder(val_name, mean_val)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = val_name, y = mean_val)) + 
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +  # Use geom_col() for bar chart
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci), width = 0.2) +  # Add error bars
  coord_flip() +
  labs(y = "Mean Value Rating", x = "Value Name", title = "Mean Value Ratings with 95% CI") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("analysis/plots/mean_val_ratings.png", width = 8, height = 6)
  
```

linear bayesian
---
```{r}
f <- bf(reap_pos ~ reap_category +
         (1|convo_id) +
         (1|reap_value))
fit <- brm(f, 
           data = df_proc,
           family = gaussian,
           chains = 4,
           cores = 4,
           iter = 5000,
           warmup = 1000,
           file = here("analysis/models/lin_pos.rds"),
           file_refit = "on_change")
           # file_refit = "always"

summary(fit)

mean(as_draws_df(fit)$b_reap_categorytop)
HDInterval::hdi(as_draws_df(fit)$b_reap_categorytop, credMass = .95)
HDInterval::hdi(as_draws_df(fit)$b_reap_categorytop, credMass = .9)
HDInterval::hdi(as_draws_df(fit)$b_reap_categorytop, credMass = .8)



epreds <- df_proc %>% 
  data_grid(reap_category = c("top", "bottom")) %>%
  add_epred_draws(fit, re_formula = NA) 
epreds %>% 
  group_by(reap_category) %>%
  summarize(
    mean = mean(.epred)
  ) %>% 
  as.data.frame
```
